actions.send-email.description: Send an email using a custom SMTP server.
actions.send-email.props.body_type.descr: How the text in Body is interpreted.
actions.send-email.props.customHeaders.d: Extra headers added to the email, as name and value pairs.
actions.send-email.props.from.descriptio: Must be an address your server lets you send from.
actions.send-email.props.replyTo.descrip: Replies go to this address instead of the sender.
actions.send-email.props.senderName.desc: Name shown in the inbox instead of your address.
auth.props.TLS.description: Fail instead of sending unencrypted if STARTTLS is unavailable.
auth.props.email.description: Login name, usually your email address. Blank if no login is needed.
auth.props.password.description: Leave blank if your mail relay does not require authentication.
auth.props.port.description: 465 encrypts from the start; other ports upgrade to STARTTLS if the server offers it.
description: Send emails using Simple Mail Transfer Protocol
